notes:
### Interface fixes

- The main window fits its playback controls at the standard size. Settings keeps a consistent bottom inset when the window is resized.
- Settings keeps its footer outside the scrolling area so advanced parameters and their help stay readable.
- Two-column controls and a compact Now Playing card bring the layout in line with the reviewed design.
- The README includes a screenshot of the macOS launcher.

Extract the ZIP and open Open SVPflow.app on Apple Silicon with macOS 26 or later. Homebrew mpv, Python, and VapourSynth are external dependencies. The app and plugins are ad-hoc signed.
